_comment: Outside-cone task under a bounded disturbance (UE-bCBF), with the ue-landing actuator limits (thrust 0-39.24 m/s^2, body rates +-18 rad/s). Base set: the 9-D hover ellipsoid beside the funnel at c = 12, large enough for the UE tube (shrunk level ~7.4 at the end of the 2 s rollout). Read by scripts/train_phase1_cone_obstacle_ue.py, scripts/compare_phase1_cone_obstacle.py and the Phase-II scripts.
